calls.title: CFI Trade & GrowthBook Check In
calls.summary: The evaluation of vendors is nearing completion, with only one company left for review. George plans to discuss outcomes with Martin to narrow down options before making further analyses. GrowthBook is identified as a leading candidate, with pricing being a critical factor in the decision. The enterprise license for GrowthBook costs $30,000 annually, plus $1,000 for each additional user seat. A new session replay feature will launch in beta next month. George aims to complete the vendor evaluation by the end of July, while budget approvals will likely extend into mid-August or early September. Integration with Power BI is planned to facilitate data use without complex setups, and a careful decision-making process is emphasized to ensure thorough evaluations.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, pricing, procurement, evaluation timeline, session replay, Power BI integration
